children: NextEra Energy announced an enhanced Virginia benefits package that doubles residential bill credits to $10/month for four years and commits to 1,000 new direct jobs in the Commonwealth.
Proposes $10/month residential bill credit extended from two to four years to provide longer-term bill relief for Virginians.
Increases EnergyShare low-income assistance by $100 million through 2038 and holds customers harmless from merger costs.
Commits to maintain Virginia headcount for five years, add 600 NextEra jobs and support 400 supplier jobs (1,000 direct jobs total).
Will build a shareholder-funded NextEra co-headquarters tower in Richmond and establish workforce and supplier programs ($100M fund; up to $1B annual supplier program for five years).
Aims to accelerate solar, storage, dispatchable resources and nuclear development in Virginia while affirming local regulation and SCC accountability.

title: NextEra Energy, Dominion unveil enhanced Virginia benefits package with $10/month credit for four years, 1,000 new jobs
